Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to assign non-Power Platform licensed Entra users to Dataverse Activities in Dataverse. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature allows non-licensed users to be assigned to Dataverse activities. These non-licensed users are created at run-time as stub users and can then be assigned to the activities.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

message.Title: Dataverse - Assign non-Power Platform licensed Entra users to Dataverse Activities
